newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy to offer Eni tranche in June - report.
newsitem.headline: Italy to offer Eni tranche in June - report.

text.p: The Italian Treasury has decided to place a third tranche of energy giant Eni on the market between June 23 and 27, financial newspaper Il Sole 24 Ore reported on Saturday.
The unsourced report said the size of the placement still had to be decided but would "certainly be between a minimum of 15 percent and a maximum of 17 percent".

In an interview with Il Mondo magazine, released on Friday ahead of publication, Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi was quoted as confirming that the third tranche of energy giant Eni will be placed on the market by the summer.
The Treasury currently holds 69 percent of Eni and is not expected to reduce its holding to below 51 percent with the third tranche placement.

Share analysts, who expect the latest sale to prove another big success, have said they believed ENI would follow its usual pattern of offering a tranche of about 15 percent. -- Rome newsroom +396 678 2505
